questions.question:
Which of the following sets of statements are correct about Inter Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)?

a. The ITCZ is a broad trough of low pressure in equatorial latitudes.

b. This is where the northeast and the southeast trade winds converge.

c. The ITCZ is the equatorial trough normally positioned about 5°N of the equator and remain there throughout the year.

d. The ITCZ moves over to the plane of Ganga in Summer.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) **a, b, and d. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ITCZ is a broad trough of **low pressure **that generally exists close to the **equator** on Earth. **So statement (a) is correct.**
 
• This is the meeting point of the** northern and southern hemispheres' trade winds,** which cause frequent thunderstorms and a lot of rain. **So statement (b) is also correct.**
 
• This zone is known for its significant movement across the equator following the sun’s zenith point, which explains its shift towards the **Ganga plain** in the summer. **So statement (d) is correct**.
 
• The statement that the ITCZ remains around 5°N of the equator throughout the year is incorrect, as the **ITCZ moves north and south of the equator seasonally,** influenced by the sun's position, rather than staying fixed near 5°N. This makes **statement (c) as incorrect.**
 
• This dynamism is a key characteristic of the ITCZ, influencing **rainfall patterns in tropical regions**.

Hence the correct option combination is **a,b and d.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Zinc oxide is a form of rust.
Copper can also turn into rust upon hydration.
Chemically rust is hydrated ferric oxide.
Chemically rust is non-hydrated ferric oxide.

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chemically rust is hydrated ferric oxide.**
 
• Rust specifically refers to the result of the corrosion of iron, forming a compound primarily consisting of hydrated iron(III) oxide **(Fe₂O₃·nH₂O).**
 
• Zinc oxide and copper do not form rust; they undergo different types of corrosion and patination, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zinc **corrodes when exposed to air and moisture.

 
 
• However, this element does not rust like most other metals. Iron, for example, reacts with water and oxygen in the atmosphere to form hydrated iron oxide on the metal's surface.
 
 
 
• **Copper** does not react with water, but it does slowly react with atmospheric oxygen to form a layer of brown-black copper oxide which, unlike the rust that forms on iron in moist air, protects the underlying metal from further corrosion.
 
• **Iron** reacts with oxygen, when exposed to moisture, it forms a chemical substance that is brown in colour and is referred to as rust.

• The **kinetic energy** of the emitted electrons depends on the** frequency (color) **of the incident light.

questions.question: The drainage system formed when rivers discharge their waters from all directions in a lake or depression, as in the case of Loktak Lake in Manipur, is called ________.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **centripetal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Centripetal Drainage Pattern:**

__
 
• It is just the opposite of the radial as streams flow toward a central depression.
 
• During wetter portions of the year, these streams feed ephemeral lakes, which evaporate away during dry periods.
 
• Sometimes, salt flats are also created in these dry lake beds as salt dissolved in the lake water precipitates out of solution and is left behind when the water evaporates away.
 
• **E.g. Loktak lake in Manipur.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Radial Drainage Pattern:**

 
• The radial drainage pattern develops around a central elevated point and is common to conically shaped features such as volcanoes.
 
• When the rivers originate from a hill and flow in all directions, the drainage pattern is known as ‘radial’.
 
• E.g. The rivers originating from the** Amarkantak range; Narmada** and **Son (tributary of Ganga).**

**Trellis Drainage Pattern:**

 
• Trellis drainage develops in folded topography where hard and soft rocks exist parallel to each other.
 
• Down-turned folds called synclines form valleys in which reside the main channel of the stream.
 
• Such a pattern is formed when the primary tributaries of main rivers flow parallel to each other and secondary tributaries join them at right angles.
 
• **E.g. The rivers in the upper part of the Himalayan region; Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra.**

**Dendritic Drainage Pattern:**

 
• It is the most common form and resembles the branching pattern of tree roots.
 
• The dendritic pattern develops where the river channel follows the slope of the terrain.
 
• The pattern develops in areas where the rock beneath the stream has no particular structure and can be eroded equally easily in all directions.
 
• Tributaries join larger streams at acute angles (less than 90°).
 
• **E.g. The rivers of the northern plains; Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra.**

questions.question: The Delhi sultan, who succumbed to injuries as a result of his fall from horse was _____.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Qutubuddin Aibak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Qutubuddin Aibak**

 
 
• Qutbuddin Aibak was the slave of Muhammad Ghori.
 
• He was a **Turkish slave** by origin after the death of Ghori, he became the master of Hindustan and founded the Slave Dynasty in 1206 AD.
 
• He was given the title of **Lakh Baksh **(giver of lakhs).
 
• He died in 1210 AD while playing *Chaugan *or horse polo.
 
• He constructed two mosques, Quwwat-ul- Islam in Delhi and Adhai din ka Jhonpra in Ajmer.
 
• He also began the construction of **238 feet high stone** tower Qutub Minar, in honour of the famous Sufi Saint, Khwaja Qutubuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki.
 
• He patronised writers like Hasan-ul Nizami, author of Taj-ul-Massir and Fakhruddin, author of Tarikh-i-Mubarak Shahi
 
• Dynasty ended when Jalal Ud din Firuz Khilji overthrew the last Mamluk ruler Muiz ud din Qaiqabad in 1290.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Razia Sultan was the first female Sultan of India in 1236.

 
 
• She was known as an efficient and just ruler.
 
• She ruled in Delhi from 1236 to 1240.
 
• She succeeded her father Shams-ud-din Iltutmish and turned into the Sultanate of Delhi.
 
 
 
• Shams ud-din Iltutmish was the third ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
 
• Iltutmish, a "**slave of a slave**" is regarded by several historians as the real founder and consolidator of the slave dynasty and the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• He was the slave and the successor of Qutubbuddin Aibak.
 
• He launched the silver tanka and the copper Jital as the regular currency.
 
• Iltutmish started the system of Iqtadari.
 
• Chahalgani or chalisa was formed by Iltutmish.
 
• He was the first to make Delhi the capital.
 
 
 
• Sultan Ghiyas-ud-din Balban ascended the throne of Delhi after the death of Sultan Nasiruddin in 1266 A.D.
 
 
• In his early life, he served as a **slave of Iltutmish and was included among the "famous Forty**" i.e. **Chahalgani or Chalisa.**
 
 

**​​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: The ______________ Five-Year Plan was the first plan to focus on gender issues, women empowerment and the growing inequalities amongst the states and inter regional disparities.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Fifth Five-Year Plan**, spanning from **1974 to 1978**, was the **first to consider gender issues **in development planning.
 
• Specific measures were implemented to **empower women economically**, **socially**, and **politically**.
 
• The plan aimed for **equity by tackling gender issues**, and **regional disparities**, and **promoting social justice** and **inclusive growth**.
 
• Emphasized **empowering women** through **education, skills training, and economic opportunities**.
 
• The plan was developed against the backdrop of **economic challenges**, including **inflation, food shortages, and a balance of payments crisis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sixth Five-Year Plan**

 
 
• The plan was from **1 April 1980 to 31 March 1985**.
 
• The scheme was based on the **Input-Output model**.
 
• In this plan, the **target growth** rate was **5.2%** and the **actual achievement **was **5.4%**.
 
 
 
• **Third Five-Year Plan**
 
 
• Period - 1960-61 till 1965-66.
 
• The plan aimed to make the **economy reach a state of economic dynamism**.
 
 
 
• **Fourth Five-Year Plan**
 
 
• The scheme started on **1 April 1969 **and ended on **31 March 1974**.
 
• It was a plan based on the **Ashok Rudra Menon model**.
 
• The** target growth rate** in this plan was set at **5.7%**, while the **achievement** was only** 3.3%**
